items.title: Why Anthropic is a more speculative bet than Visa: Bill Ackman
items.summary: Pershing Square Capital Management CEO Bill Ackman joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss why he feels Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) is a more speculative bet than Visa (V). While sharing his favorite risk/reward stocks.
